name: rosetta-file-size
code:
use default

report(label: string, path: string) is
    if IO.File.exists(path) then
        write_line("{label}: {IO.FileInfo(path).length} bytes")
    else
        write_line("{label}: does not exist")
    fi
si

let local_path =
    IO.Path.combine(System.Environment.current_directory, "input.txt")

IO.File.write_all_text(local_path, "hello, rosetta code!")
report("input.txt (current directory)", local_path)
IO.File.delete(local_path)

report("/input.txt (file system root)", "/input.txt")
